mapper.select: SELECT DATE(account_date) AS date, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expense, COUNT(*) AS count FROM account_book WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND account_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY DATE(account_date) ORDER BY date
